interoperability_corrections: MIT SPNEGO needs an explicit SPNEGO credential alongside Kerberos in the acceptor union credential; independent Python GSSAPI reproduces Kerberos-only union rejection.
Samba SMB2 requests mutual authentication and integrity without GSS confidentiality (returned flags 302); SMB keeps its own mandatory signing/encryption, while NFS still requires all three GSS flags.
Samba deliberately rejects localhost Kerberos targets; clients authenticate the exact files.taucloud.test FQDN while routing TCP to 127.0.0.1.
